# Data

## Load and tidy

Loading the pre-processed data already obtained form the CMD repository

```{r}
processed.data.path.CMD <- file.path("..","DataSources","CMD","QS_expdata_processed.rds")
all_expdata <- readRDS(processed.data.path.CMD)
```

Prepare data for models

```{r}
# remove identified outlier?
# sample_excl <- "HMP2_J05379_M_ST_T0_B0_0120_ZOZOW1T-44_H15WVBG"
sample_excl <- "Nothing_To_Remove"

fit_data <- list(species = t(all_expdata$species[,colnames(all_expdata$species) != sample_excl]),
                pathways = t(all_expdata$pathways[,colnames(all_expdata$pathways) != sample_excl]))

sample_metadata <- all_expdata$sample_metadata[rownames(all_expdata$sample_metadata) != sample_excl,]
sample_metadata$study_code <- substr(sample_metadata$study_name,1,3)

sample.response <- sample_metadata$response
sample.study <- sample_metadata$study_code
studies <- unique(sample.study)
studies
```

Metadata

```{r}
species_metadata <- all_expdata$species_metadata
pathways_metadata <- all_expdata$pathways_metadata
```

Tidy up names for species block

```{r}
# create new variable in metadata
species_metadata$species_short <- substr(
  species_metadata$species_id,
  unlist(regexpr(":",species_metadata$species_id))+1,
  nchar(species_metadata$species_id)
)

# adjust names
rownames(species_metadata) <- species_metadata$species_short
colnames(fit_data$species) <- species_metadata$species_short
```

Export metadata for interpretation later on

```{r}
saveRDS(pathways_metadata,file.path(plot_folder,'pathways_metadata.rds'))
saveRDS(species_metadata,file.path(plot_folder,'species_metadata.rds'))
```

Check counts of observations and variables

```{r}
lapply(fit_data,function(x){dim(x)})
```

Counts by study and response

```{r}
table(sample.study, sample.response)
```

Check missing values

```{r}
mean(is.na(all_expdata$species))
mean(is.na(all_expdata$pathways))
```


## Unwanted variation adjustment

Specify model to be taken into account

```{r}
# specify a model based on the response that will be used
mod <- model.matrix(~as.factor(sample.response))
```

ComBat adjusted data

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
fit_data.combat <- lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(ComBat(t(x), batch = sample.study, mod=mod))
})
```

RBE adjusted data

```{r}
fit_data.RBE <- lapply(fit_data, function(x){
   t(removeBatchEffect(t(x), batch = sample.study, design=mod))
})
```


## Unwanted variation in raw data

Get PCs for each block

```{r}
fit.pca <- lapply(names(fit_data), function(block){
    PCA <- mixOmics::pca(X = fit_data[[block]], ncomp = 2, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)$variates$X
    PCA <- as.data.frame(scale(PCA))
    PCA$block <- block
    PCA$Class <- as.factor(sample.response)
    PCA$Study <- as.factor(sample.study)
    return(PCA)
})

fit.pca <- do.call(rbind,fit.pca)
```

Plot to examine unwanted variation

```{r}
ggplot(fit.pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Study)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major=element_blank()
    , strip.text = element_text(size = 16)
    , axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
    # , axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    , axis.text = element_blank()
    , axis.ticks = element_blank()
    , legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
    , legend.text = element_text(size = 14)
    # ,legend.position="none"
    ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_Set1)

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'PCA.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 

```


# Benchmarking with all data

## Choose inputs

```{r}
ncomp <- 2
keepX <- list(species=rep(50,ncomp), pathways=rep(50,ncomp))
# change design matrix to improve classification aspect
design.ratio.X = 0.10
```

## Fit using all data

```{r}
fit.block.splsda.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
fit.block.splsda.combat.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.combat, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
fit.block.splsda.RBE.full <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.RBE, Y = sample.response, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
fit.mint.block.splsda.full <- mint.block.splsda(X = fit_data, Y = sample.response, study=sample.study, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
```

# Benchmark using subsets

## Fit models 

block.splsda on raw data

```{r}
fit.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.splsda on combat adjusted data - combat applied to each subset independently

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.splsda.combat <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train = lapply(fit_data, function(y){
      t(ComBat(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain], mod = model.matrix(~as.factor(Y.train))))
      })
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

block.splsda on RBE adjusted data - RDE applied to each subset independently

```{r, message=FALSE}
fit.block.splsda.RBE <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){
      t(removeBatchEffect(t(y[InTrain,]), batch = sample.study[InTrain], design = model.matrix(~as.factor(Y.train))))
      })
  fit <- block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

mint.block.splsda fit

```{r}
fit.mint.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTrain <- !is.element(sample.study,x)
  Y.train <- sample.response[InTrain]
  fit_data.train <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTrain,]})
  sample.study.train <- sample.study[InTrain]
  fit <- mint.block.splsda(X = fit_data.train, Y = Y.train, study = sample.study.train, ncomp = ncomp, keepX = keepX, design = design.ratio.X)
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

## Extract features and compare stability across subsets

Extract and plot for all fits

```{r}
fits <- list(
  "DIABLO" = fit.block.splsda,
  "DIABLO_combat" = fit.block.splsda.combat,
  "DIABLO_rbe" = fit.block.splsda.RBE,
  "MINT Block" = fit.mint.block.splsda
)

#####
# stability using all components
####

selection_frequency_th <- length(fits[[1]]) * (1/2)
# features selected in > selection_frequency_th studies put in the 'more' group

fit.feature.props <- extract.fit.feature.props(
  fits = fits, 
  blocks = names(fit_data), 
  selection_frequency_th = selection_frequency_th,
  begin_comp = 1,
  end_comp = ncomp
  )

# plot the feature selection proportions by fit and block and frequency
ggplot(fit.feature.props) + 
  geom_col(aes(x = selection_frequency, y = proportion_of_features, fill = fit), position = 'dodge') + 
  labs(
    x = "Selection frequency",
    y = "Proportion of variables"
    ) +
  facet_grid(~block) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")+
  labs(fill = "Fit")

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'stability_all.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'stability_all.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 

# print proportion of features selected across all fits

print(
  fit.feature.props[fit.feature.props$selection_frequency==max(fit.feature.props$selection_frequency),]
)

# print proportions by frequency group

fit.feature.props.group <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit, selection_frequency_group) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion_of_features)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.group$proportion <- round(fit.feature.props.group$proportion,2)

print(fit.feature.props.group)

# print weighted stability score by block and model

fit.feature.props.global <- fit.feature.props %>%
  group_by(block, fit) %>%
  summarise(ave_freq = sum(wghtd_freq)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
fit.feature.props.global$stability <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq / length(studies),2)
fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq <- round(fit.feature.props.global$ave_freq,2)

print(fit.feature.props.global)

```

## Make predictions for held out studies

predict using block.splsda model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using block.splsda.combat model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda.combat <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda.combat[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using block.splsda.RBE model

```{r}
pred.block.splsda.RBE <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  pred <- predict(object = fit.block.splsda.RBE[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

predict using mint.block.splsda model

```{r}
pred.mint.block.splsda <- sapply(studies, function(x){
  InTest <- is.element(sample.study,x)
  pred_data.test <- lapply(fit_data, function(y){y[InTest,]})
  sample.study.test <- sample.study[InTest]
  pred <- predict(object = fit.mint.block.splsda[[x]], newdata = pred_data.test, study.test = sample.study.test)
  Y.test <- sample.response[InTest]
  pred.actual <- list(
    pred = pred,
    Y.test = Y.test
  )
}, simplify = FALSE, USE.NAMES = TRUE)
```

## Compare predictions

Choose which metrics to use

```{r}
prediction.distance <- c("max.dist", "centroids.dist", "mahalanobis.dist")[1]
prediction.type <- c("AveragedPredict.class", "WeightedPredict.class", "MajorityVote", "WeightedVote")[4]
error.type <- c("BER","ER")[1]
```

Extract predictions and actuals

```{r}
predictions <- list(
  "DIABLO" = pred.block.splsda,
  "DIABLO_combat" = pred.block.splsda.combat,
  "DIABLO_rbe" = pred.block.splsda.RBE,
  "MINT Block" = pred.mint.block.splsda
)

classifications.all.models <- extract.classifications(
  predictions = predictions,
  pred.method = prediction.type,
  pred.distance = prediction.distance
  )

classifications.all.models$IfError <- !classifications.all.models$IfCorrect

```

Calculate error

```{r, message=FALSE}

# BER by model and study
classifications.BER.study <- classifications.all.models %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name, study.actuals) %>%
  summarize(
    ErrorRate = round(mean(IfError),2)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER = round(mean(ErrorRate),2)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame()
classifications.BER.study

# balanced error rate
classifications.BER <- classifications.all.models %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name, study.actuals) %>%
  summarize(
    ErrorRate = mean(IfError)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name, study.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER = mean(ErrorRate)
    ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(model.name) %>%
  summarize(
    BER.mean = round(mean(BER),2),
    BER.sd = sd(BER),
    # BER.n = n(),
    BER.se = round(sd(BER)/sqrt(n()),3)
    ) %>%
  # mutate(BER.se = round(BER.sd/sqrt(BER.n),3)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
classifications.BER
  
```

Plot the average BER by fit

```{r}
classifications.BER$lower <- classifications.BER$BER.mean - 2*classifications.BER$BER.se
classifications.BER$upper <- classifications.BER$BER.mean + 2*classifications.BER$BER.se

ggplot(classifications.BER) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = model.name, y = BER.mean, colour = model.name)) + 
  # geom_col(aes(x = model.name, y = BER.mean, fill = model.name)) + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = model.name, ymin = lower, ymax = upper
                    , colour = model.name
                    )
                ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fit",
    y = "BER"
    ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    legend.position="none"
    ) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'BER.pdf'), width = 10, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'BER.png'), width = 10, height = 10, units = "cm") 
```


# In depth analysis with MINT Block

## Tune number of components

Parameters

```{r}
ncomp = 7
```

Using the new tuning function

```{r}
tuned.mint.block.plsda <- tune.mint.block.plsda(
  X = fit_data,
  Y = sample.response,
  study = sample.study,
  ncomp = ncomp,
  design = design.ratio.X
)
```

Plot errors for new tuning function

```{r}
plotdf <- tuned.mint.block.plsda$loocv.ncomp$errors.global$BER
# line graph from plotdf with ncomp on the x axis and error rate on the y axis
# with a different line for each prediction method
ggplot(plotdf, aes(x = ncomp, y = mean, color = prediction.method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    # title = "CMD",
       x = "Number of components",
       y = "BER") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    # panel.grid.major=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")

ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'ncomp.pdf'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm") 
ggsave(file.path(plot_folder,'ncomp.png'), width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm")  
```


Method that gave min overall but with error bars

```{r}
plotdf <- tuned.mint.block.plsda$loocv.ncomp$errors.global$BER
best.prediction.method <- unique(plotdf$prediction.method[plotdf$mean==min(plotdf$mean)])[1]
plotdf <- plotdf[
  is.element(plotdf$prediction.method,best.prediction.method),
  ]
# line graph from plotdf with ncomp on the x axis and error rate on the y axis
# with a different line for each prediction method
ggplot(plotdf, aes(x = ncomp, y = mean, color = prediction.method)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se)) +
  labs(
    # title = "GBR",
       x = "Number of components",
       y = "BER") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(
    # panel.grid.major=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired")
```


By study

## Tune number of variables

What combo gives best overall error?

```{r}
ncomp <- 2
test.keepX = list(species = c(25,50,75), pathways = c(25,50,75))

tuned.mint.block.splsda.global = tune.mint.block.splsda(
  X = fit_data,
  Y = sample.response,
  study = sample.study,
  ncomp = ncomp,
  test.keepX = test.keepX,
  design = design.ratio.X,
  prediction.distance = prediction.distance,
  prediction.type = prediction.type,
  error.type = error.type,
  use.ttest = FALSE
)

# export results as the tuning is time consuming
saveRDS(tuned.mint.block.splsda.global,file.path(plot_folder,'tuned.mint.block.splsda.global.rds'))

# import saved tuning results
tuned.mint.block.splsda.global <- readRDS(file.path(plot_folder,'tuned.mint.block.splsda.global.rds'))
```


Display results


create heatmap data for each component using a loop

```{r}
ndisplay <- 25
species_select_comp <- vector("list")
pathways_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_select_comp <- vector("list")
annot_colors_comp <- vector("list")
samples_annotation_comp <- vector("list")
samples_gaps_comp <- vector("list")
features_annotation_comp <- vector("list")
features_gaps_comp <- vector("list")

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
  
  # select features form each block
  species_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[,comp_to_plot]))
  # species_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[,comp_to_plot]!=0
  species_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (species_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  pathways_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[,comp_to_plot]))
  # pathways_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[,comp_to_plot]!=0
  pathways_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (pathways_rank <= ndisplay)
  
  # loadings to select
  species_loadings_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[species_select,comp_to_plot]
  pathways_loadings_select <- fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[pathways_select,comp_to_plot]
  loadings_select <- c(species_loadings_select, pathways_loadings_select)
  
  # observed data (scaled by study)
  X_select <- cbind(
    fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$species[,species_select],
    fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$pathways[,pathways_select]
  )
  
  # annotate features
  features_annotation <- data.frame(
    Block = as.factor(c(
      rep('species',sum(species_select)),
      rep('pathways',sum(pathways_select))
    )),
    # Type = as.factor( c(
    #   species_metadata$superkingdom[species_select],
    #   rep('N/A',sum(pathways_select))
    # )),
    Phylum = as.factor( c(
      species_metadata$phylum[species_select],
      rep('N/A',sum(pathways_select))
    ))
  )
  
  rownames(features_annotation) <- colnames(X_select)
  
  # reorder features based on block and loading
  feature_order <- order(features_annotation$Block, loadings_select)
  features_annotation <- features_annotation[feature_order,]
  X_select <- X_select[,feature_order]
  mean(colnames(X_select)==rownames(features_annotation))
  
  # set the cut points based on the grouping
  features_gaps <- integer()
  for (i in 2:length(features_annotation$Block)){
    if(features_annotation$Block[i]!=features_annotation$Block[i-1]){
      features_gaps <- c(features_gaps,i)
    }
  }
  
  # annotate samples
  samples_annotation <- data.frame(
    Batch = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$study,
    Status = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$Y
  )
  rownames(samples_annotation) <- rownames(X_select)
  sample_order <- order(samples_annotation$Status, samples_annotation$Batch)
  
  # reorder the samples based on grouping
  samples_annotation <- samples_annotation[sample_order,]
  X_select <- X_select[sample_order,]
  mean(rownames(X_select)==rownames(samples_annotation))
  # set the cut points based on the grouping
  samples_gaps <- integer()
  for (i in 2:length(samples_annotation$Status)){
    if(samples_annotation$Status[i]!=samples_annotation$Status[i-1]){
      samples_gaps <- c(samples_gaps,i)
    }
  }
  
  # set colours for annotations
  annot_colors <- list(
    Block = my_Paired[c(10,11)],
    # Type  = my_Set3[1:nlevels(features_annotation$Type)],
    Phylum  = my_Paired[1:nlevels(features_annotation$Phylum)],
    Batch = my_Set1[1:nlevels(samples_annotation$Batch)], 
    Status = brewer.pal(5, "Set1")[c(2,5)]
    )
  
  names(annot_colors$Block) <- levels(features_annotation$Block)
  # names(annot_colors$Type) <- levels(features_annotation$Type)
  names(annot_colors$Phylum) <- levels(features_annotation$Phylum)
  names(annot_colors$Batch) <- levels(samples_annotation$Batch)
  names(annot_colors$Status) <- levels(samples_annotation$Status)
  
  # save for the component
  species_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- species_select
  pathways_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- pathways_select
  X_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_select
  annot_colors_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- annot_colors
  samples_annotation_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- samples_annotation
  samples_gaps_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- samples_gaps
  features_annotation_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- features_annotation
  features_gaps_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- features_gaps
  
}
```

### Check over-representation of taxa

```{r}
for (grouping_to_test in c('phylum','family','order')){
  for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){

    species_metadata[,"incl"]<-species_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]

    OR.test.df <- data.frame(
      group = species_metadata[,grouping_to_test],
      incl = species_metadata[,"incl"]
    )

    OR.rates <- OR.test.df %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(incl_rate = mean(incl)) %>%
      as.data.frame()

    OR.rates$total_rate <- mean(OR.test.df$incl)

    OR.rates <- OR.rates[order(-OR.rates$incl_rate),]
    GroupsToTest <- OR.rates$group[c(1:min(3,length(OR.rates$group)))]
    RatesToTest <- OR.rates$incl_rate[c(1:min(3,length(OR.rates$group)))]

    # loop through groups to check OR and adjust the pvalue for multiple testing

    incl <- as.character(OR.test.df$incl)
    incl[incl=="TRUE"] <- "in"
    incl[incl=="FALSE"] <- "out"
    incl <- as.factor(incl)
    fisher_tests <- vector("list")
    Groups_pvalues <- numeric()

    for (g in GroupsToTest){
      group <- OR.test.df$group
      group[group!=g] <- "z_other"
      group <- as.factor(group)
      test_result <- fisher.test(x = group, y = incl, alternative = "greater", 
                                 simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
      fisher_tests[[g]] <- test_result
      pvalue <- test_result$p.value
      Groups_pvalues <- c(Groups_pvalues,pvalue)
    }

    OR.tests <- data.frame(
      Group = GroupsToTest,
      Rate = round(RatesToTest,3),
      PValue = round(Groups_pvalues,3),
      AdjPValue = round(p.adjust(Groups_pvalues, method = "BH"),3)
    )

    print(paste0("Component: ", comp_to_plot))
    print(paste0("Group: ", grouping_to_test))
    print(OR.tests)

  }
}
```

```{r}
for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){
  
  cor_Mat <- fit.network.all$M_species_pathways
  #remove rownames suffix
  rownames(cor_Mat) <- substr(rownames(cor_Mat),1,nchar(rownames(cor_Mat))-8)
  colnames(cor_Mat) <- substr(colnames(cor_Mat),1,nchar(colnames(cor_Mat))-9)
  # filter to include those for the component
  cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[is.element(rownames(cor_Mat),names(species_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[species_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]]),]
  cor_Mat <- cor_Mat[,is.element(colnames(cor_Mat),names(pathways_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]])[pathways_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]])]
  
  # get metadata
  species_metadata_cor_Mat <- species_metadata[rownames(cor_Mat),]
  pathways_metadata_cor_Mat <- pathways_metadata[colnames(cor_Mat),]
  
  # set annotation colours for the plot
  species_annotation <- data.frame(
      Phylum = as.factor(species_metadata_cor_Mat$phylum)
    )
  rownames(species_annotation) <- rownames(cor_Mat)
  
  annot_colors <- list(
    Phylum  = my_Paired[1:nlevels(species_annotation$Phylum)]

      show_colnames = TRUE,

      annotation_col = species_annotation
    )
  
  ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("heatmap_cor_comp",comp_to_plot,".pdf")),

}
```

### Boxplots for selected features


```{r}
ndisplay <- 10
X_species_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_pathways_select_comp <- vector("list")
X_select_comp <- vector("list")

for (comp_to_plot in 1:ncomp){

  # select features form each block
  species_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[,comp_to_plot]))
  species_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$species[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (species_rank <= ndisplay)
  pathways_rank <- rank(-abs(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[,comp_to_plot]))
  pathways_select <- (fit.mint.block.splsda.full$loadings$pathways[,comp_to_plot]!=0) & (pathways_rank <= ndisplay)

  # sample annotation
  samples_annotation <- data.frame(
    Sample_id = rownames(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$species),
    Batch = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$study,
    Status = fit.mint.block.splsda.full$Y
  )

  # observed data (scaled by study)
  X_species_select <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$species[,species_select])
  X_pathways_select <- as.data.frame(fit.mint.block.splsda.full$X$pathways[,pathways_select])

  # merge observed data with sample annoations
  X_species_select <- cbind(samples_annotation,  X_species_select)
  X_pathways_select <- cbind(samples_annotation,  X_pathways_select)

  #reshape to long format
  X_species_select <- reshape(
    data = X_species_select,
    direction = "long",
    idvar = c("Sample_id", "Batch", "Status"),
    varying = list(colnames(X_species_select)[-c(1:3)]),
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Feature",
    times = colnames(X_species_select)[-c(1:3)]
  )

  X_pathways_select <- reshape(
    data = X_pathways_select,
    direction = "long",
    idvar = c("Sample_id", "Batch", "Status"),
    varying = list(colnames(X_pathways_select)[-c(1:3)]),
    v.names = "Value",
    timevar = "Feature",
    times = colnames(X_pathways_select)[-c(1:3)]
  )

  # add feature annotations
  species_metadata_long <- species_metadata[X_species_select$Feature,]
  X_species_select$Type <- species_metadata_long$phylum
  X_species_select$Block <- "species"

  pathways_metadata_long <- pathways_metadata[X_pathways_select$Feature,]
  X_pathways_select$Type <- "pathways"
  X_pathways_select$Block <- "pathways"

  #append
  X_select <- rbind(X_species_select, X_pathways_select)

  # save
  X_species_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_species_select
  X_pathways_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_pathways_select
  X_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]] <- X_select

}
```

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("boxplots_species_comp",comp_to_plot,".png")),
       width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")

# pathways boxplots

X_select <- X_pathways_select_comp[[comp_to_plot]]
ggplot(X_select, aes(x = Feature, y = Value, fill = Status)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(Batch~.) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 2), "cm"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank()
    ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(5, "Pastel1")[c(2,5)])

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("boxplots_pathways_comp",comp_to_plot,".pdf")),
       width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_folder,paste0("boxplots_pathways_comp",comp_to_plot,".png")),
       width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")
```
